description: Release the DSH process a conversation occupies (this frees the write lock so the user can open the same conversation in their own DSH GUI). The conversation stays on disk and can be resumed later; **forget=true writes a tombstone**: it is removed from the registry and later lookups by id say it was forgotten (to bring it back, delete the tombstone file named in the error, by default `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-any-agent-forgotten/<id>.json`). To free memory in one go when you are done, pass all=true (each conversation is about 300-480 MB; the default `MAX_LIVE=4` already reaps the least recently used one; all=true releases **idle** conversations and skips ones running a turn unless force=true). Releasing a single conversation stops its DSH process; if a turn is running, it is interrupted.

all.description: Ignore conversation_id and release every **idle** conversation process (to free memory). Conversations running a turn are skipped by default. Default false.

conversation_id.description: Conversation id, from dsh_start or dsh_list.

force.description: Only with all=true: also stop conversations that are running a turn (those turns are interrupted). Default false.

forget.description: Also remove it from this server's registry. Default false.

name: dsh_release
title: Release conversation
